title: Quickshell Shell Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Quickshell Hyprland shell. Place your config at ~/.config/quickshell/shell/config.json. Hot-reload is supported — the file is watched and changes apply immediately.

source.description: 'wallpaper' — generate Material You colors from the current wallpaper. 'custom' — use a fixed seed color (not yet implemented).

variant.description: Material color scheme variant. 'vibrant' and 'tonalspot' are the most commonly used. Controls how saturated the generated palette is.

position.description: Bar position. Currently only 'top' is supported.

margin.description: Gap between bar and screen edge in logical pixels.

widgets.description: Ordered list of bar widgets. Rendered left-to-right within each section.

enabled.description: Whether this widget instance is active.

section.description: Bar section where this widget appears.

monitors.description: Monitors to show this widget on. 'all' or a monitor name (e.g. 'DP-2') or an array of monitor names.

clickAction.description: What to open when the widget is left-clicked.

settings.description: Widget-specific settings. See per-type documentation below.

showWindows.description: [workspaces] Show window dots inside workspace chips.

showIcon.description: [activewindow, weather, media, battery, network] Show an icon.

format.description: [clock] Qt date/time format string, e.g. 'HH:mm' or 'HH:mm:ss'.

showDate.description: [clock] Show abbreviated date below the time.

compact.description: [media] Compact mode — show icon and truncated title only.

maxWidth.description: [activewindow, media] Maximum width of the widget text in pixels.

scrollable.description: [volume] Allow changing volume by scrolling on the widget.

iconSize.description: [tray] System tray icon size in pixels.

spacing.description: [tray] Spacing between tray icons in pixels.

dashboard.description: Dashboard panel (4-tab control center). Toggle with the configured hotkey or by clicking clock/widgets in the bar.

width.description: Dashboard panel width in logical pixels.

height.description: Dashboard panel height in logical pixels.

historyTTLDays.description: Automatically delete notification history entries older than this many days. Set to 0 to disable pruning.

panel.description: Notification center sidebar (opened via bell icon or IPC).

width.description: Width of the notification center panel in pixels.

groupByApp.description: Group notifications by application in the notification center.

popup.description: Transient notification popups that appear when a notification arrives.

timeout.description: Default popup auto-dismiss timeout in milliseconds (used when urgency-specific timeout does not apply).

timeoutCritical.description: Auto-dismiss timeout for critical notifications (ms). Set to 0 to never auto-dismiss critical notifications.

maxVisible.description: Maximum number of notification popups shown simultaneously.

launcher.description: Application launcher with fuzzy search, calculator, and clipboard history.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results shown per provider.

listMaxHeight.description: Maximum height of the results list before scrolling (pixels).

topMargin.description: Distance from the top of the screen to the launcher in pixels.

providers.description: Active search providers. 'applications' — installed apps. 'calculator' — inline math (requires qalculate-glib). 'clipboard' — clipboard history (requires cliphist).

hiddenApps.description: Application desktop file IDs to hide from search results, e.g. ['org.kde.dolphin.desktop'].

osd.description: On-screen display overlays shown when volume or brightness changes.

timeout.description: Time in milliseconds before the OSD auto-hides after the last change.

lockscreen.description: WlSessionLock-based lockscreen. Activated by lockScreen() IPC or loginctl lock-session.

enabled.description: Enable the built-in lockscreen. When false, lock actions will still work if an external locker intercepts the session lock signal.

blurWallpaper.description: Apply blur to the wallpaper behind the lock UI.

showClock.description: Show a large clock on the lockscreen.

confirmActions.description: Show a confirmation step before executing destructive actions (reboot, shutdown, logout).

actions.description: Which actions to show in the power menu. Order is preserved.

gamingMode.description: Gaming mode temporarily disables visual effects for better performance. State persists across restarts — previously saved Hyprland settings are restored when disabled.

disableWeather.description: Pause weather API refreshes while gaming mode is active.

disableWallpaperChange.description: Pause wallpaper auto-cycling while gaming mode is active.

hyprland.description: Hyprland compositor settings to override via hyprctl when gaming mode is enabled. Previous values are saved and restored on disable.

gaps.description: Override general:gaps_in and general:gaps_out to this value. Use -1 to leave gaps unchanged.

rounding.description: Override decoration:rounding to this value. Use -1 to leave rounding unchanged.

wallpaper.description: Multi-monitor wallpaper management. Wallpapers are applied via swww or a custom script.

primaryMonitor.description: Monitor name (e.g. 'DP-1') whose wallpaper is used to generate the Material You color palette. Empty string uses the first monitor.

defaultWallpaper.description: Fallback wallpaper path used when no per-monitor path is configured.

postSetScript.description: Shell command executed after each wallpaper change. The new path is available as $WALLPAPER_PATH.

global.description: Global wallpaper cycling settings applied to all monitors without per-monitor overrides.

directory.description: Directory to cycle wallpapers from. Leave empty to disable cycling.

randomOrder.description: Cycle wallpapers in random order. False = alphabetical.

enabled.description: Automatically cycle wallpapers on a timer.

intervalMs.description: Wallpaper cycle interval in milliseconds. Default is 5 minutes (300000).

monitors.description: Per-monitor wallpaper overrides. Keys are monitor names (e.g. 'DP-1', 'HDMI-A-1'). Each value is an object with optional 'path' and 'directory' fields.

path.description: Static wallpaper path for this monitor.

directory.description: Wallpaper cycling directory override for this monitor.

weather.description: Weather data via Open-Meteo API (no API key required).

location.description: Location display name shown in weather widgets.

refreshMinutes.description: How often to refresh weather data, in minutes.

calendar.description: Local calendar integration (reads GNOME/Evolution calendar SQLite databases).

reminders.description: Desktop notification reminders for upcoming calendar events.

enabled.description: Send a desktop notification (via notify-send) before calendar events.

minutesBefore.description: How many minutes before an event to send the reminder notification.

enabled.description: Enable VPN status tracking and quick-toggle in the dashboard.

name.description: NetworkManager VPN connection name to monitor and toggle.

workspaceCount.description: Number of workspaces displayed in the workspaces bar widget.
